questions.question: What led Solomon's heart away from the LORD?
options: His vast wealth and love of luxury
His many foreign wives and their gods
His endless wars with distant nations
His pride in his own great wisdom
questions.answer: His many foreign wives and their gods

questions.question: What did God say would happen to the kingdom because of Solomon's sin?
options: It would be torn apart, but not in his lifetime
It would be carried into exile in Babylon
It would remain whole under his wise son
It would fall to Egypt within a single short year
questions.answer: It would be torn apart, but not in his lifetime

questions.question: Solomon built high places for the gods of his foreign wives.
Solomon's many foreign _____ turned his heart after other gods.
God told Solomon he would tear the _____ from his son, leaving one tribe for David's sake.
